titles.title: Annual Mammogram and Prostate Cancer Screening Coverage Act of 1998

To amend the Public Health Service Act, the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to require that group and individual health insurance coverage and group health plans provide coverage of annual mammograms and annual prostate cancer screening tests following the model established under the Medicare Program.
Annual Mammogram and Prostate Cancer Screening Coverage Act of 1998
